reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing single definition getScheduledAmount and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the range and approximate rules each appear once, and the tree has no other copy of the worst-case computation.

placement.why: The planning rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where every planning consumer already gets it.

scope.why: Only the helper and its tests change; the test edits just restate the cases for the new rule.

maintainability.why: A two-line rule with a comment stating the intent, in the one place all callers use.
